definitions.explanation: The figure obtained by adding up a set of values and dividing by how many there are. Used wherever data is summarized: test scores, measurements, survey results, and economic statistics.

examples.japanese: {平均値|へいきんち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}した→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{数値|すうち}→数値：12913_suuchi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{平均値|へいきんち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やや→やや：03642_yaya⟧⟦{上回|うわまわ}っている→上回る：07648_uwamawaru⟧。
examples.english: This figure is slightly above the average.

examples.japanese: ⟦{極端|きょくたん}→極端：13161_kyokutan⟧な⟦{値|あたい}→値：21704_atai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{平均値|へいきんち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正|ただ}しく→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦{表|あらわ}さない→表す：01868_arawasu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When there is one extreme value, the mean sometimes fails to represent the data accurately.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{平均|へいきん}→平均：03614_heikin⟧ (average) plus {値|ち} (value). In casual speech people often just say ⟦{平均|へいきん}→平均：03614_heikin⟧; {平均値|へいきんち} is the precise term used when contrasting it with other statistics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平均値|へいきんち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to find the mean
- {平均値|へいきんち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上回|うわまわ}る→上回る：07648_uwamawaru⟧: to exceed the average
- {平均値|へいきんち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下回|したまわ}る→下回る：07649_shitamawaru⟧: to fall below the average
- ⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{平均値|へいきんち}: the overall average

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{最大値|さいだいち}→最大値：30158_saidaichi⟧ / ⟦{最小値|さいしょうち}→最小値：30166_saishouchi⟧: maximum / minimum value
